exclusions.source_text: greater than or equal to (\>=) 18 years old
Eastern cooperative oncology group (ECOG) performance status 0-1 and life expectancy of at least 3 months

Participants with Inflammatory breast cancer or leptomeningeal disease or brain metastases, with the exception of patients with definitively treated brain metastases that are clinically stable and asymptomatic for \>2 weeks and who are off or receiving low-dose corticosteroid treatment (\<=10 mg prednisone or equivalent) for at least 2 weeks prior to start of study treatment.
Active or uncontrolled infection (controlled HIV or treated hepatitis C allowed)
Another malignancy requiring treatment within 2 years (except low-risk, curatively treated cancers)
